gloss_en: Minchah — the meal-offering of fine flour and, by extension, the afternoon Minchah prayer instituted by Isaac; associated with the aspect of judgments (dinim)

outliers.actual_gloss_en: rest, tranquility (menuchah) — here the aspect of prophecy, per 'and he saw rest that it was good' (Gen 49:15) and 'rest I have not found' (Jer 45:3)
outliers.reason: Defective spelling מְנֻחָה of מְנוּחָה ('rest'), a different lexeme (root נו"ח) from מִנְחָה ('offering/afternoon prayer', root מנ"ח); homograph mis-assignment.
